title: OAB & Mirabegron Training
welcomeTitle: Overactive bladder and mirabegron: guided training
welcomeText: This module walks you from the disease (pathophysiology to treatment), through the EAU guidelines, to mirabegron's mechanism and its phase 3 trial programme.
placeholder: Ask any question, e.g. “Compare BEYOND and BESIDE” or “What does EAU say about older patients?”
footer: For internal scientific training. Data are summarised from published literature and EAU guidelines (2025 editions). Always check the locally approved prescribing information (SFDA) before discussing a product with healthcare professionals.

title: Datroway: HR+/HER2− Breast Cancer Training
welcomeTitle: Datroway in HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer: guided training
welcomeText: This module covers HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer from biology to treatment sequencing, the ESMO and NCCN guideline positions, Datroway's mechanism, the TROPION-Breast01 trial and how to manage its key side effects.
placeholder: Ask any question, e.g. “What were the PFS and OS results in TROPION-Breast01?”
footer: For internal scientific training. Data are summarised from the US prescribing information, published trials and ESMO/NCCN guidelines (as of November 2026). Check the locally approved prescribing information (SFDA) and local registration status before discussing with healthcare professionals.

title: Datroway: First-line TNBC Training
welcomeTitle: Datroway in first-line metastatic TNBC (not candidates for immunotherapy): guided training
welcomeText: This module covers triple-negative breast cancer from biology to first-line decision-making, the ESMO and NCCN guideline positions, Datroway's mechanism, the TROPION-Breast02 trial and how to manage its key side effects.
placeholder: Ask any question, e.g. “Which patients are not candidates for immunotherapy?”
footer: For internal scientific training. Data are summarised from the US prescribing information, published trials and ESMO/NCCN guidelines (as of November 2026). Check the locally approved prescribing information (SFDA) and local registration status before discussing with healthcare professionals.

title: Datroway: EGFR-mutated NSCLC Training
welcomeTitle: Datroway in previously treated EGFR-mutated NSCLC: guided training
welcomeText: This module covers EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer from biology to post-osimertinib sequencing, the NCCN and ASCO guideline positions, Datroway's mechanism, the TROPION-Lung05 and Lung01 data behind the US accelerated approval, and key side-effect management.
placeholder: Ask any question, e.g. “What does accelerated approval mean for this indication?”
footer: For internal scientific training. This indication has US accelerated approval only (not EU). Data are summarised from the US prescribing information, published trials and NCCN/ASCO guidelines (as of November 2026). Check SFDA registration status and the local prescribing information before discussing with healthcare professionals.
